notes.title: TimeLost Is Now Fully Released – Play Free Today!
notes.content:
[h3]After 3 years in development, we're proud to announce that TimeLost has officially launched out of Early Access — and it's completely Free to Play!

⚔️ [b]TimeLost[/b] is a [b]Soulslike Team-Based PvP Arena Fighter[/b]. Master precise, stamina-based combat, customize your dual-weapon loadout, and battle through time-warped arenas in intense solo and team modes.[/h3][p][/p][h3]🛡️ [b]Key Features:[/b][/h3][h3][b]Competitive Solo & Team Modes[/b]: 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 6v6 (TDM & Control)[/h3][h3][b]Soulslike stamina combat[/b] focused on blocking, dodging, and punishing mistakes[/h3][h3][b]Dual-weapon loadouts[/b] for personalized playstyles[/h3][h3][b]Stylized characters[/b] with unique flair and customizations[/h3][h3][b]No pay-to-win[/b] — only skill, strategy, and timing
[/h3][hr][/hr][h3]
[i][b]Whether you're a fighter testing your reflexes or a tactician outsmarting the enemy, TimeLost delivers a high-stakes PvP arena experience like no other![/b][/i][b]
[/b][/h3][h3][b]💬 Join our community, squad up, and help shape the future of the game:[/b]
[b]👉 [url="https://discord.gg/HECQcq6P4g"]https://discord.gg/HECQcq6P4g[/url][/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 Play Free Now and prepare for the fight of your life![/b][/h3][h3][/h3][h3][b]See you in the Arenas.[/b][/h3][h3][b]         — [i]The TimeLost Devs[/i][/b][/h3]

notes.title: TimeLost is Out Now in Early Access
notes.content:
Dear TimeLost Community,

We are thrilled to announce that TimeLost is now available in Early Access on Steam! This pivotal moment in our development journey invites you to step into the fray and experience the intense, time-bending combat that defines TimeLost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822840/b25189427b5d5a574104dc1373df6e6d4bb47c9b.png[/img]
Join the Battle Today!

Dive into various multiplayer modes, including 5v5, 3v3, 2v2, and 1v1, and master an array of unique weapons, stimulants, upgrade chips, and abilities. Whether you prefer strategic team play or solo challenges, TimeLost offers a dynamic battlefield tailored to your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822840/113176fb1b7554d123410e3f9d6552b919d9f213.png[/img]

Your Feedback Shapes Our Future

Early Access marks the beginning of our collaborative journey with you, our dedicated players. Your insights and feedback are invaluable as we strive to enhance performance, refine gameplay mechanics, and expand content. We encourage you to share your experiences and suggestions through our community channels, including the Steam forums and our official Discord server.

Stay Connected

Keep up-to-date with the latest news, updates, and community events by following our official channels:

Steam Community Hub: Engage with fellow players, participate in discussions, and access the latest announcements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822840/4452151302efd82ccefc8e683264ed33527d41af.png[/img]
Discord Server: Join live conversations with the development team and other players, share feedback, and stay informed about upcoming events.

We are excited to embark on this journey with you and look forward to shaping the future of TimeLost together. Thank you for your support, and we'll see you on the battlefield!


The TimeLost Development Team
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822840/db2a34ec8775bcbff6a50c643a7645df8fcc316a.png[/img]

notes.title: Join The Fight - March 14!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822840/22ed1bfa8a450ee6f68080fd74ce67ffd0967327.png[/img]

Gear up for battle! [b]TimeLost[/b] is launching into Early Access on March 14, 2025. Master precise timing and strategic abilities to outplay your opponents in various modes, including 5v5, 3v3, 2v2, and 1v1. Customize your playstyle with a diverse selection of weapons, stimulants, upgrade chips, and abilities.

[b]TimeLost[/b] is a Soulslike Team-Based PvP Arena Fighter. Master precision combat, customize your playstyle through dual-weapon builds, and climb the ranks in Arenas that transcend space and time.

[b]TimeLost Early Access Features:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Prepare for Battle:[/b] Enter the arena equipped with two distinct weapons, each offering unique skills. Your selections not only define your combat style but also impact your health and dodge capabilities. Strategize and customize to dominate the battlefield.

[*][b]Master The Art of Defense:[/b] Defend with precision by balancing blocks and dodges. Absorb damage with well-timed blocks, but depleting your stamina leaves you exposed. Evade strikes and debuffs with perfectly timed dodges, gaining brief invulnerability. Strategy and reflexes are the keys to dominating the arena.

[*][b]Intense Combat with Endless Strategy:[/b] Engage in fast-paced battles where strategy and precision are key. Compete in ranked arenas, skirmishes, or control points—each match brings new challenges. Customize builds to heal allies, debilitate enemies with status effects, and turn the tide of battle.

[*][b]Visit the Black Market:[/b] The Black Market is the in-game shop where you can purchase new Weapons, Stimulants, Upgrade Chips, and other visual aesthetics to customize your character and weapons. You can acquire currency from competing in matches.

[*][b]NO MICROTRANSACTIONS!:[/b] [b]TimeLost [/b]will always be Free to Play! The only purchase you can make is for our [b]Complete Armory Edition DLC[/b], which only speeds up unlocking your loadout to experience the full [i]Vault [/i]quicker!
[/list]

[b]Why Early Access?[/b]
“We believe that involving the community early in the development of TimeLost is crucial to crafting an engaging and balanced multiplayer arena fighter. Early Access allows us to gather valuable feedback, address bugs, and refine features based on player input, ensuring the game resonates with all players.”

notes.title: Stimulants and Upgrade Chips Update
notes.content:
[b]We have added a BUNCH of stimulants and upgrade chip options to help flesh out your build a bit more. [/b]

[h3]Stimulants (Actives)[/h3]
Health Stim- Regen Health immediately
Regen Stim- Restores health over time
Swifty Stim- Increase move speed
Destro Stim- Sacrifice health to deal damage
Grav Stim- Pull your enemies in close
Reap Stim- Negate damage
Shut Down Stim- Stun targets
Burning Man Stim- Burn all enemies around you
Rejuv Stim- Regen Health and stamina
Deep Breath Stim- Instantly regen Stamina
Purge Stim- Cleanse yourself of negative effects
StoneSkin Stim- Prevent all knockdowns, knockups, knockbacks, and stuns.


[h3]Upgrade Chips (Passives)[/h3]
Regen Chip heal over time
Cardio Chip- Increase max stamina
Bloodbag Chip- Increase max health
Sacrifice Chip- Reduce max health
UV Chip- Burn immunity
Antidote Chip- Poison immunity
Clotting Chip- Bleed immunity
Mercury  Chip- Slow immunity
Poise Chip- Immunity to knockdowns and knockups
Immoveable Chip- Immunity to knockbacks and pulls
Reinforced Chip- All blocking is now shielded blocking

[b]This introduces new items to mix up build potentials all around![/b]

notes.title: UI and Market Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822840/2ca8b2617f20f8ae87dab85151aae0ce49e278ab.png[/img]We know its been July since our last Steam update post, but fear not as we have been hard at work implementing the Market into the game. Once this update goes live, you will be able to purchase weapons, armors, stimulants and upgrades to your character using currency acquired from playing matches. [b](We still will not be doing microtransactions)[/b] We also have plans for more item types beyond that.

We have done a lot of work on improving on the design of your character customization as well.

On TOP of that, we have been working on bug fixes and revisiting maps, abilities and more to put us in the best state for the game before entering [b]Early Access[/b] which is planned for this month!

Anyhow, thank you to everyone who has contributed to testing and providing feedback as we push our game forward.

If you would like to provide more testing, please reach out to us in our Discord!
